m.adaptation: natural nasal segment; no looping or time stretching; gain normalization and 5ms edge fades

l.adaptation: isolated consonant segment repeated with crossfades to 0.6 seconds; gain normalization; 20ms fade in/out

n.adaptation: isolated consonant segment repeated with crossfades to 0.6 seconds; gain normalization; 20ms fade in/out

f.adaptation: isolated consonant segment repeated with crossfades to 0.6 seconds; gain normalization; 20ms fade in/out
